# HR Automotive

> Family-run car body repair, bodywork, paint specialist and mobile mechanic in Halifax, West Yorkshire. We also sell quality used cars, repaired and prepared in-house.

Tagline: Family Run. Professionally Done.
Location: Halifax, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Phone: 07521 417466
Email: HRautomotivefamily@gmail.com

## About
HR Automotive is a family-owned bodyshop and garage in Halifax offering
professional accident and collision repair, bodywork, dent and scratch removal,
panel replacement, paintwork and resprays, insurance repairs, alloy wheel
repairs, affordable oil changes and servicing, and full vehicle restoration —
professional results without dealership prices. We are also a mobile mechanic:
if you can't get to us, we come to you across Halifax and Calderdale. We also
sell affordable used cars that we repair and prepare ourselves.

## Areas served
Halifax, Calderdale, Brighouse, Elland, Sowerby Bridge, Hebden Bridge,
Huddersfield, Bradford and the wider West Yorkshire.

## Services
- Mobile mechanic — repairs and servicing at your home or roadside
- Accident & collision repairs
- Bodywork and panel repair / replacement
- Dent removal and scratch repairs
- Paintwork, resprays and colour matching
- Insurance repairs (handled directly)
- Alloy wheel repairs
- Oil changes and routine servicing (affordable)
- Vehicle restoration
- Used car sales
